clause_text: Your access to and use of the LazyPay website and the LazyPay Services are conditional upon your acceptance of and continuous compliance with these T&C at all times.
By availing the LazyPay Services, you agree to be bound by these T&C, including any additional guidelines and future modifications issued by PayU from time to time.
If at any time you do not agree with these T&C, you shall immediately cease your use of such LazyPay Services.
The access to the LazyPay website and/or the LazyPay Services is only available to persons who are competent to enter into legally binding contracts under the Indian Contract Act, 1872.

PayU provides to the LazyPay Users payment facilitation services for purchase of product or service on specific merchant websites or outlets, wherein the LazyPay User shall be provided with the option to carry out checkout transaction processing at Partner Merchant websites and providing invoicing services and payment management systems in relation to the purchase of products or services from the Partner Merchant, subject to a maximum credit of INR 2,500.
In order to render the LazyPay Services, PayU may partner with the Partner Merchant and/or third party banks or financial institutions, as may be determined by PayU, in its sole discretion.
The LazyPay User availing the LazyPay Services shall be entitled to make payment of the purchase price of the products, subject to monetary limits specified by PayU.
You hereby consent and agree that PayU, acting on behalf of the Partner Merchant and/or the third party bank or financial institution, may share your information as necessary to process transactions.

E-mandate means authorization by the User to auto debit a User's bank account or another form of account such as a wallet through an electronic mandate such as an e-mandate or an e-NACH or through any other mode as may become available from time to time.
The Cardmember can use the Card to access cash in an emergency from ATMs in India or abroad.
A transaction fee of 2.5% (Minimum Rs.500) would be levied on the amount withdrawn.
The transaction fee is subject to change at the discretion of HDFC Bank.
HDFC Bank retains the right to alter any charges or fees from time to time or to introduce any new charges or fees, as it may deem appropriate, with due intimation to customer.
HDFC Bank at its sole discretion will determine the Cardmember's credit limit and cash withdrawal limit.
HDFC Bank will review the Cardmember account periodically, may decrease the Cardmember credit limit based on internal criteria.
Late Payment Charges will be applicable if Minimum Amount Due is not paid by the payment due date.
Late payment charges are applicable as: Less than Rs.100 - Nil, Rs.100 to Rs.500 - Rs.100, Rs.501 to Rs.5000 - Rs.400, Rs.5001 to Rs.10000 - Rs.500, Rs.10001 and above - Rs.750.
Over limit charges are applicable on total outstanding exceeding the Credit Limit at the rate of 2.5% of the over limit amount subject to minimum of Rs.500.
Please note that the Finance Charges and other charges are subject to change at the discretion of HDFC Bank.
All the Contents of the statement will be deemed to be correct and accepted if the Cardmember does not inform HDFC Bank of the discrepancies within 60 days of the Statement Date in writing.

The bank, at any time and without notice, will have lien and right to set-off on all monies belonging to the Cardmember and/or add on Cardmember standing to their credit in any account/custody of the bank, if upon demand by the bank, the balance amount on the card account is not repaid within the prescribed time.
The Bank may restrict/terminate the use of the Card without any further notice, if the Bank reasonably believes it necessary in the interest of the Cardholder and for security reasons.
Bank shall have a right to run periodic checks on the Credit Card usage.
Based on the usage patterns, if any of these is suspected by the Bank, Bank may take restrictive action on the Credit Card.
Bank's decision in this regard shall be final and binding on the customers.
No annual, joining or renewal fees shall be refunded on a pro-rata basis.
The death or incapacitance of a Cardmember, insolvency, dissolution, bankruptcy or winding up of a corporate body of a Cardmember shall automatically cancel the card issued to the Cardmember.
All amounts outstanding on the Card Account shall be deemed to have immediately become due on death or incapacitance.
The Bank is not liable or responsible for any transaction incurred on the card account prior to time of reporting of the loss of the card, and the Cardmember will be wholly liable for the same.
If the Cardmember has acted fraudulently the Cardmember will be liable for all losses.
If the Cardmember acts without reasonable care, the Cardmember may be liable for all losses incurred.

The Bank reserves the right to cancel or suspend Reward Points accrued on the Credit Card if it is in arrears, suspension or default or if the Card Account is or is reasonably suspected to be operated fraudulently.
Reward Points earned but not redeemed at the time of death of the Cardmember shall be forfeited.
If the Credit Card is not used for more than 365 days, Reward Points accrued will be nullified.

The Cardmember acknowledges that as per existing business practices, the Bank can disclose from time to time any information relating to the Credit Card(s), to any credit bureau (Existing or Future) without any notice to the customer.

The bank will, at its own discretion, record specific conversations between the Cardmember and the representative of the Bank, in cases of grievance-related conversation or payments-recovery-related conversations or any other conversations, that the Bank may deem fit.
Bank has the right to withdraw the Priority Pass membership or any other benefit associated with your credit card if your card is closed or remains inactive for more than 90 days.

The Most Important Terms and Conditions (MITC) are to be read and understood in conjunction with the IDFC FIRST Bank Credit Card Member Terms and Conditions/Agreement as communicated on the Bank's website.
The transaction fee is subject to change at the sole discretion of IDFC FIRST Bank from time to time with prior notice to the Card member and disclosed via the Bank's website.
Interest will be charged at up to 3% per month (36.00% annualized) as per the sole discretion of IDFC FIRST Bank and shall be final and binding to the Card member.
The charges are subject to change at the discretion of IDFC FIRST Bank from time to time, with the updated schedule published on the Bank's website.

If the Card member is using the revolving credit facility of the IDFC FIRST Bank Credit Card, interest will be charged on the outstanding amount from the date of transaction until full payment is received.
Clear funds need to be credited to the IDFC FIRST Bank Card Account on or before the payment due date, to avoid Late Payment Charges.
Annual and renewal membership fees, once charged, are non-refundable even if the card is cancelled or surrendered during the membership period.

The Bank reserves the right to investigate any dispute or discrepancy raised by the Card member, and the Bank's determination following such investigation shall be final and binding on the Card member.
The Bank may terminate, revoke, or transfer the Card membership at its discretion, including in cases of loss, theft, or suspected misuse of the Credit Card, without prior notice to the Card member.

We must be informed of any event or occurrence that may give rise to a claim under this Policy within 14 days of the diagnosis of the first occurrence.

An Insured Person must submit the requisite claim documents and information establishing the circumstances of the claim, its quantum, and Our liability for the claim within 60 days of the diagnosis, failing which the claim may not be payable unless the Insured Person has complied with all obligations under this Policy.
We will not cover any person above the age of 66 for an annual policy and 67 for a 2-year policy.
If the policy is renewed within 15 days from the due date of renewal, the policy cover shall continue without a break;
however, any claim incurred during the break-in period will not be payable under this policy.
This Policy constitutes the complete contract of insurance.
This Policy cannot be changed or varied by anyone, including an insurance agent or broker, except Us, and any change We make will be communicated in writing.
This Policy will automatically terminate at the end of the Policy Period and We are under no obligation to notify the Insured Person of such termination.
Any act or omission made in a dishonest or fraudulent manner under or in relation to this Policy or the renewal of the Policy poses a moral hazard and may result in the Policy being voided.

No insurance agents, brokers, or other person or entity is authorised to receive premium on Our behalf or to make any representation or promise on Our behalf that is not contained in this Policy wording.

Any recovery We make pursuant to this clause shall first be applied to the amounts paid or payable by Us under this Policy and Our costs and expenses of effecting such recovery, before any balance is paid to the Insured Person.
The free health check-up benefit under a family floater policy cannot be availed by any member if any single member covered under the policy has raised a claim during the preceding four policy years.

All fees and charges applicable to the loan must be clearly disclosed to the borrower upfront in the Key Fact Statement and loan agreement, and no fee outside this disclosure may be levied at any later stage of the loan tenor.
Penal charges shall be reasonable, non-discriminatory, and standardized across similar product categories, and shall not be compounded or added to the regular interest rate charged on the loan.

Penal charges will be clearly disclosed in the loan agreement, Key Fact Statement, and via SMS, email, or app notifications at the time they are levied, rather than left for the borrower to discover only upon reviewing a statement.
No penal charges will be levied in case of disputes, technical failures, or delays arising from force majeure events outside the borrower's control.

The Annual Percentage Rate includes the interest rate, processing fee, documentation charges, and insurance if bundled, and any other fee known at the time of sanction, and shall be calculated using a standardized formula rather than left to the lender's discretion.

A digitally signed Key Fact Statement shall be mandatorily provided to the borrower before disbursal, and shall clearly mention all fees, charges, interest rate, Annual Percentage Rate, penal charges, recovery mechanisms, and the cooling-off period, among other key terms.
Processing fees are charged once before disbursal and are non-refundable, including in cases where the loan is cancelled shortly after disbursal.
Daily penal charges are optional for demand loans and, where applied, compound on a daily basis for every day the repayment remains outstanding past the due date.

Charges for switching between loan products, statement re-issuance, mandate cancellation, and cheque re-issuance are each levied separately and are not included within the headline interest rate quoted to the borrower at the time of sanction.

As per the terms and conditions outlined in the Transaction Documents, the Borrower is obligated to repay the Loan, including interest, fees, and other charges, by the due dates specified in the repayment schedule.

The Lenders will have the right to share the Borrower's default details with Credit Information Companies (CICs), and a default history against the Borrower's name could jeopardize the Borrower's future creditworthiness.
The Lenders may, as per standard terms and conditions, recall the entire loan amount advanced in view of any default committed by the Borrower in repaying the EMIs as per the repayment schedule.

Failure to pay the overdue amount within the specified notice period may result in the lenders sharing default details with credit agencies and initiating legal proceedings for recovery, without further individual notice to the Borrower.

The Borrower entered into a Loan agreement and other related Transaction Documents with the Lenders at the time of loan disbursal, and continued use of the loan facility constitutes acceptance of all terms contained therein, including those incorporated by reference.
The Key Fact Statement must disclose the total interest charge during the entire tenor of the loan, in Rupees, as a single clearly stated figure.
Other up-front charges, if any, must be disclosed with a break-up of each component, including processing fees and insurance charges, given separately rather than bundled into one figure.
The net disbursed amount to the borrower equals the loan amount minus all up-front charges, and this net figure must be shown to the borrower distinctly from the gross loan amount.

The total amount to be paid by the borrower over the life of the loan, being the sum of the loan amount, total interest, and all up-front charges, must be disclosed as a single annualized percentage rate figure for ease of comparison across lenders.

The rate of annualized penal charges in case of delayed payments, if any, must be disclosed upfront in the Key Fact Statement, along with the rate of any other annualized penal charges that may apply.
Contact details of the nodal grievance redressal officer designated specifically to deal with digital lending related complaints must be disclosed to the borrower.

Penal charges will be based on the outstanding amount of the loan and shall be reasonable and non-discriminatory, and standardized across similar product categories, rather than compounded or calculated as penal interest added to the regular interest rate.

No charge or fee other than those disclosed in the Key Fact Statement at the time of sanction shall be charged by the lender to the borrower during the loan tenor without the borrower's explicit consent.

Processing fees, charged once before disbursal, foreclosure charges, and part-prepayment charges must each be disclosed as a distinct line item rather than folded into a single combined "other charges" figure.

Disbursement of the loan amount would be made post deduction of the processing fee, insurance charges, and any other applicable charges, meaning the amount credited to the borrower's account may be meaningfully lower than the sanctioned loan amount.
